versions.content: If an SdServiceGroup is started by Sd_ServiceGroupStart() , the AUTOSAR Service Discovery module shall set all SdClientServiceS which are referencing the affected SdServiceGroup to SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_REQUESTED and all SdServerServiceS which are referencing the affected SdServiceGroup to SD_SERVER_SERVICE_AVAILABLE .

If an SdServiceGroup is started by Sd_ServiceGroupStart() , the AUTOSAR Service Discovery module shall set all SdClientServiceS which are referencing the affected SdServiceGroup to SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_REQUESTED and all SdServerServiceS which are referencing the affected SdServiceGroup to SD_SERVER_SERVICE_AVAILABLE .

If an SdServiceGroup is started by Sd_ServiceGroupStart(), the AUTOSAR Service Discovery module shall set all SdClientServiceS which are ref- erencing the affected SdServiceGroup to SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_REQUESTED and all SdServerServiceS which are referencing the affected SdServiceGroup to SD_ SERVER_SERVICE_AVAILABLE.
